title: catboost-5fold-baseline
hypothesis: CatBoost's symmetric oblivious trees yield distinct split dynamics from depthwise XGBoost and leafwise LightGBM. Benchmarking a 5-fold CatBoost baseline on Deotte features (--freq --te) establishes standalone capacity and provides diverse OOF predictions for multi-GBDT ensembling.
train_args: exp0029: CatBoost 5-fold baseline on Deotte freq+TE features
